type.description: primary: instruction -> its primaryCategory. category: undirected co-category pair between two instructions. belongs: instruction -> materialized category node (requires includeCategoryNodes). link: directed instruction -> instruction edge materialized from the source entry's structured `links` array.

rel.description: Link relationship type. Present only when type='link'. Mirrors links.items.properties.rel on the instruction schema; absent `rel` on the stored link is materialized as 'related'.

label.description: Human-readable annotation copied from the stored link. Present only when type='link' and the stored link carried a non-empty label. Derived inverse edges carry the same label as the stored link they came from.

inverse.description: True when this edge was derived at query time by reversing a stored link rather than read from an entry's `links` array. Links are stored one-way only; inverse edges are materialized in enriched mode for the reversible rels (prerequisite, sequel, part-of, related) and never for see-also. Read the reversed direction through `rel`: (rel='prerequisite', inverse=true) on B->A means 'B is required by A'; likewise sequel means 'B follows A' and part-of means 'B contains A'. `related` is symmetric, so its inverse carries the same meaning in the opposite direction. When both A->B and B->A are stored for the same rel, the stored edges win and no inverse edge is added.
